discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer product page, global configuration and image source
discovery.result: Official global product page lists Dimensity 810, 6GB+128GB, 11GB including dynamic RAM, 6.6-inch IPS FHD+ display described as 60Hz, triple camera, 7.98mm thickness, 4500mAh battery and 22.5W charging. Its USD price and Notify Me control do not establish a current Philippine price or stock.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer product article and rear camera cross-check
discovery.result: Official article dated 2022-12-23 describes the V41 Vita's 7.98mm body, 50MP main camera, 2MP depth camera and 2MP macro camera.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer product introduction and global configuration
discovery.result: ZTE's official product-introduction video, published 2022-12-12, names the V41 Vita 5G and lists Dimensity 810, 6GB RAM, 128GB ROM, 4500mAh and 22.5W charging.
Reports the Blade V41 Vita announcement on 2022-12-07. Used as announcement timing, not a verified first-sale transaction date.
Singtel's 5G SA handset list explicitly pairs ZTE 8140N with V41 Vita 5G. This is model identity/network support evidence, not Philippine availability.
ZTE's own end-of-promotion/software-update notice lists external model ZTE 8140N. The marketing-name link is corroborated separately by Singtel's device list.

discovery.source_kind: Contemporaneous Philippine launch, price and specifications
discovery.result: Local article dated 2023-02-21 reports ZTE's Philippine return, V41 Vita 5G, PHP 11,999, Dimensity 810, 6GB/128GB, cameras, 4500mAh and 22.5W charge.
Local article dated 2023-02-21 reports the V41 Vita 5G in the Philippine Blade-series introduction and lists PHP 11,999 for 6GB+128GB.
Article dated 2023-02-22 reports the Blade V41 Vita 5G released in the Philippines at PHP 11,999, with 6GB RAM and 128GB storage. Its publication date follows the 2023-02-21 launch reports.
Local report dated 2023-02-22 lists 6GB+128GB, 2408×1080, 90Hz, Wi-Fi 6, NFC, 5G/4G, dual SIM and local PHP 11,999 pricing.

discovery.source_kind: Hands-on Philippine review and specification-conflict review
discovery.result: Review of a local unit reports a 60Hz display and a frosted-glass back; its own specification summary later lists 90Hz. The refresh-rate discrepancy is preserved as unresolved.
Lists 6GB RAM, 128GB storage, 1080×2408, 90Hz, Dimensity 810, 50+2+2 cameras, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, NFC, 5G and MyOS 12/Android 12.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine configuration, camera, connectivity and historical launch-price cross-check
discovery.result: Local coverage lists one 6GB/128GB configuration at PHP 11,999, 1080p/30 video, 1TB microSD, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5, NFC, 5G/4G, USB-C OTG, Li-Po 4500mAh battery and a July 2023 promotional price context.
ZTE kiosk opening story dated 2023-07-17 reports a temporary V41 Vita 5G reduction from PHP 11,999 SRP to PHP 9,999 through July 31, 2023.

discovery.result: Checked 2026-11-27. The official global page displays USD 229 and a Notify Me control; it does not publish a PHP price or establish Philippine stock. YugaTech's Philippine price-list history for this model is dated 2023, so no current PHP price is asserted.
